name: Beet Generation Farm
tagline: Join Our Farm Share — BEET GENERATION FARM
description: Beet Generation Farm is a CSA (community-supported agriculture) farm in Sebastopol, CA. Members receive a season-long share of the farm's harvest, supporting local growing while getting fresh, seasonal produce. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
